title: Document H25 artifact metadata confinement gap
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add four inert files in `research/h25-metadata-confinement-gap/` documenting a concrete missing boundary. The unchanged public full caller requires `runtime.chmod(493)` (0755), while Linux v6.12 Landlock filesystem rules do not restrict chmod. Blanket metadata denial breaks that positive call; blanket allowance with generic seccomp rules does not prove artifact-only metadata confinement.

This is a source-based negative result. It claims no observed GCC escape, universal impossibility, current-kernel experiment, completed implementation, full-caller execution, performance or mathematical improvement. The explicit chmod establishes the positive edge without assuming a CPython reference release equals the selected installed distribution.

## Task and overlap

Original investigation: [#6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Original benchmark: [#6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Direct dependencies: [#6744](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6744), `1ac58a84b725bd6f17eec66727edc877c49c7e66`, readable full caller; [#6715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6715), `dc34598c22e2ef43ae7e11fc1d8c14de3915cf89`, source archive; [#6736](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6736), `0f2a86fa9ef0daf760b77c662a5b762e17848598`, actual capture/guardian/retention ownership components. The latter supply reusable lifetime components, not a metadata service. Existing source is preserved; no broad novelty claim is made.

Canonical main base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, freshly refreshed without drift. Explicitly authorized publication of a scoped negative result. Scope is refined to this public source finding and the minimum unresolved interface; original full-caller criteria remain open. The process-fallback and compiler-temporary-directory questions remain resolved. No new implementation or research is started by delivery.

## Validation

Preparation checks only the exact four-file inventory, ordinary non-executable file modes, JSON syntax, hashes, license equality and text scope. `EVIDENCE.json` binds the 104,276-byte caller to SHA-256 `fa9f473320e9df3a2328bd8388f12eca4e7fc3eeed9289f7fdbf2eeb32a7452f` and links the exact public source spans. The README links the Linux v6.12 Landlock limitation, Git blob `33745642f7875a17261fc584322a46f8c894b86f`, and seccomp filter/notification documentation.

No project import, candidate replay, compiler/native execution, kernel probe or scientific workload was run. No executable checker or `VERIFY.json` replay hook is included. Hosted planning and skipped replay supply no scientific execution credit. Source review and byte integrity do not establish an installed-kernel result.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight; Douglas R. Colkitt and the original H25/CrocSwap authors, independent-oracle/review owners, predecessor contributors and cited Linux authors. Substantial OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro assistance, with distinct GPT-6.1-sol Max source review. AI review is separate from human, proof-kernel and runtime acceptance. New text/metadata is Apache-2.0; the exact Apache license is retained, and cited external sources are not copied or relicensed.

## Open next questions

Select and independently review a genuine artifact-only metadata interface, or a proved filesystem view covering every accessible alias. The first decisive contract must bind the actual target and effect, preserve real errno, order and partial effects, prevent path/descriptor substitution and cross-root aliases, retain caller/mediator death and pending-operation uncertainty, and connect all handles and requests to genuine ownership and sealing. A notification followed by continuation of the original unsafe syscall does not settle those obligations. No standalone simulated broker or new financial service closes this gap.
